cases.name: basic
cases.about: On ten buckets five wide, two batches each give their own cells in key order, overlapping intervals summed.

cases.name: midnight_wrap
cases.about: On a day of minutes in microseconds, trips across midnight count in the last minutes and the first, in key order.

cases.name: midnight_edges
cases.about: A trip ending at 00:00 stops at 23:59, one starting at 00:00 counts in minute 0, and a start a day later is the same minute.

cases.name: longer_than_the_grid
cases.about: On four buckets, ten buckets from bucket 3 count once per pass (3, 2, 2, 3), and four count each bucket once.

cases.name: one_bucket
cases.about: On a ring of one bucket every length counts whole, and a zero length nothing.

cases.name: zero_and_negative_lengths
cases.about: A length of zero, of minus one or of Int64's least covers nothing.

cases.name: negative_starts_floor
cases.about: With step 10 and size 6, position -1 is in bucket 5, -60 in bucket 0 and -61 in bucket 5.

cases.name: nulls_skip_the_row
cases.about: A null group, start or length skips its row; the other rows count.

cases.name: sliced
cases.about: Rows 2 to 5 of eight count, with a null among them, and the rows around them do not.

cases.name: empty
cases.about: A batch of zero rows gives a batch of zero rows.

cases.name: no_batches
cases.about: No batches give no rows.

cases.name: domain_dense
cases.about: With the domain [0, 3] every group is in it and the cells are those of no domain.

cases.name: no_domain
cases.about: With no domain the same batch gives the same cells.

cases.name: domain_miss
cases.about: With the domain [1, 2], group 3 is outside it: the batch is counted on the sparse table and gives the same cells.

cases.name: domain_miss_below_and_null
cases.about: A group below the domain counts, a null row is skipped, and an interval from the last bucket wraps.

cases.name: extremes
cases.about: Groups at Int32's ends and starts at Int64's ends, on the widest ring, 2^31 - 1 buckets.

cases.name: occupancy
cases.about: Sixty real trips of January 2024 give Occupancy as written's cells (0.6.6's function), across midnight, over four hours, backwards and of no time.

cases.name: overflow_refused
cases.about: Two lengths of Int64's largest on a ring of one overflow the count, and the batch is refused.

cases.name: step_zero_refused
cases.about: A step of zero is refused at configure.

cases.name: size_too_large_refused
cases.about: A size past 2^31 - 1 is refused at configure.

cases.name: domain_too_large_refused
cases.about: A domain whose dense table would pass 2^24 cells is refused at configure.

cases.name: unknown_parameter_refused
cases.about: A parameter the kernel does not take is refused at configure.

cases.name: wrong_type_refused
cases.about: A group column of Int64 is refused at plan.
